w: While having lunch this afternoon Swamishri emphasized the principle of honesty to the hostel students while appearing for exams: "You should not dream to 'steal' or copy in exams. Study and read daily. Don't think of passing by copying. Because when you come here (in the hostel) then you will not make efforts. If you have this motive of stealing then when you grow you will steal, and take bribes, be dishonest in your business or at work. What will you gain by stealing? You will not get peace of mind. So at present remember God and work hard…"
More than 110 devotees participated in the maha-puja (prayers for peace), in the presence of Swamishri and senior sadhus.

The evening assembly was held at the Indian Embassy auditorium. The Indian Ambassador, H.E. Prabhu Dayal, lauded the BAPS activities and Swamishri's personality to an august gathering. Swamishri then blessed the Ambassador and appreciated his assistance for his stay in Kuwait.
The Defence Minister of India, Mr. George Fernandes, specially travelled to Sarangpur to seek the darshan and blessings of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. ( See News report ).
Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of arti and pujan of the murtis for the BAPS hari mandir in Dharampur (S. Gujarat).

Today marked the 27th patotsav of Yagnapurush Smruti mandir, built over the cremation spot of Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj. Swamishri performed the pujan of Shastriji Maharaj’s murti and then the patotsav arti. After his morning puja, Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Maharaj’s arrival in this village has made it pure. Wherever God stays becomes a place of pilgrimage. Maharaj went to Dwarika, Jagannathpuri, Rameshwar and other places, and so they are all places of pilgrimage. Similarly, Maharaj stayed here and celebrated festivals, so it has become a pilgrim place. “The great benefit for us is that this is our last birth. There will be no need to come on this earth again. We will go to Akshardham. There is no need to question ‘What will happen now?’ ‘How will it happen?’, etc. We have attained Maharaj and his Sadhu, Shastriji Maharaj, so we are liberated.”

21 April 2008, (V.S. 2064, Chaitra Vad Padvo) The world’s leading musical fountain and water show creator Yves Pepin of France, came for Swamishri’s darshan. With him were team members John Jossifakis and James Thomson. After puja, Swamishri welcomed them with garlands. They had visited Delhi and Gandhinagar Akshardhams and were touched by the simplicity of Swamishri’s and the sadhus’ lifestyles. Yves pepin commented, “However big the shows I do they are temporary. When the show finishes everything ends. But Akshardham is eternal. All my shows are for entertainment, but the shows you do are inspiring.”

After the darshan of Thakorji, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was coming down by lift. In front, near the neem tree, stood Priyakantbhai, who is blind. Although he has been blind for years, he goes around selling incense sticks for a living, and whenever Swamishri comes he never fails to come for darshan.

Swamishri's eyes fell on him. As soon as he saw this very ordinary and poor seeker, Swamishri himself raised his hand. Even though he knew the man was blind, Swamishri took note of him and instructed the sadhus, "Bring him up to my residence for darshan."

ds.t: Jai Swaminarayan to the blind devotee
w: When Mahant Swami Maharaj goes to the assembly hall to give the devotees the benefit of puja darshan, a blind devotee, Kishorbhai Gadhiya, stands every day inside Hrishikeshdas Swami's office below and has Swamishri's darshan through the glass. Swamishri too casts a compassionate glance on him and sends him "Jai Swaminarayan." Today Swamishri said to the attendant sadhu, "Ask someone to tell that man standing inside my Jai Swaminarayan."
The notice Swamishri took of that devotee, who sees with the eye of wisdom, eased the pain of the devotee's blindness.
